label: Cotton et al. (2008)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, surface and borehole) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Cotton et al. (2008)

site.anchor_note: RESOLVED for the surface branch from the SB/SC/SD coefficients, with A as reference. The borehole branch instead carries a single S_200m term.

mechanism.anchor_note: Neither branch carries a mechanism term in the anchor.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for both branches. PGA coefficients for surface (a, b, c, d, e, SB, SC, SD) and borehole (a, b, c, d, e, S_200m) with their sigmas are now available.

implementation_notes: Preserve surface/borehole distinctions if present in the version coded.
Implement the paper's own small-event distance handling rather than converting distances generically.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Large Japanese database, distinct from the global NGA models.

resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G
